github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: This is the Anthropic MCP reference servers repo. Each server lives in src/<name>/ and is a standalone TypeScript or Python npm workspace. Always use the @modelcontextprotocol/sdk patterns from existing servers as reference.
For TypeScript servers: import from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/index.js and @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/stdio.js. Use ES modules (type: module). Build output goes to dist/.
Prefer explicit error types and use Zod schemas for input validation matching the MCP spec.
